knowledge:
- key_parameters: methy=Path to the tabix-indexed bgzipped methylation data file or a ModBamFiles object ;; samples=A data frame containing sample names and experimental groups ;; exons=A data frame containing exon annotations with specific columns (gene_id, chr, strand, start, end, transcript_id, symbol) ;; heatmap=Logical, whether to plot a read-level heatmap in plot_gene() ;; anno_regions=A data frame of genomic regions (e.g., DMRs) to highlight in plots ;; labels=Labels for samples in MDS/PCA plots (set to NULL to plot without labels) ;; groups=Grouping factor for coloring samples in MDS/PCA plots ;; NanoMethViz.site_filter=Global option to filter out low-coverage sites (default is 3) ;; NanoMethViz.highlight_col=Global option to change the highlight color of annotated regions (default is "grey50")
- alternatives: ModBamResult/ModBamFiles can be used instead of NanoMethResult when working directly with modBAM files (from dorado or Megalodon) to avoid converting to tabix format ;; bsseq/DSS (via methy_to_bsseq()) should be preferred for formal differential methylation testing ;; edgeR (via bsseq_to_edger()) should be preferred for count-based differential methylation analysis over sites or regions
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have single-read methylation calls (5mC CpG or other modifications) from ONT sequencing (dorado, modkit, Megalodon, Nanopolish, f5c) and want to visualize average methylation profiles alongside single-read heatmaps and gene annotations, or perform exploratory dimensionality reduction.
- pitfalls: Do not use read.table() on full tabix datasets as it decompresses all data and will take a very long time ;; Modkit BED files are not supported because they do not contain read-level information, only position-aggregated data ;; Windows users will have sorting performed in-memory (which can be highly memory-intensive), whereas Linux/macOS use the memory-efficient bash sort utility ;; In modBAM files, sequencing errors can produce false modification calls; use the NanoMethViz.site_filter option to remove low-coverage sites to reduce noise.

workflows.name: tabular_data_import_and_plotting
workflows.intent: Import tabular methylation calls, convert them to tabix format, construct a NanoMethResult object, and plot gene-level methylation.
input: methy_calls.tsv.gz (tabular methylation calls from Nanopolish, f5c, Megalodon, or Modkit)
sample_anno.csv (sample annotation table with sample and group columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert tabular files to tabix format using create_tabix_file() ;; 2. Retrieve exon annotations using get_exons_mm10() or get_exons_hg19() ;; 3. Define sample annotations ;; 4. Construct the NanoMethResult object ;; 5. Plot methylation patterns using plot_gene()
workflows.code:
methy_calls <- system.file(package = "NanoMethViz",
    c("sample1_nanopolish.tsv.gz", "sample2_nanopolish.tsv.gz"))
methy_tabix <- file.path(tempdir(), "methy_data.bgz")
samples <- c("sample1", "sample2")
create_tabix_file(methy_calls, methy_tabix, samples)
exon_tibble <- get_exons_mm10()
sample <- c(
  "B6Cast_Prom_1_bl6", "B6Cast_Prom_1_cast",
  "B6Cast_Prom_2_bl6", "B6Cast_Prom_2_cast",
  "B6Cast_Prom_3_bl6", "B6Cast_Prom_3_cast"
)
group <- c("bl6", "cast", "bl6", "cast", "bl6", "cast")
sample_anno <- data.frame(sample, group, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
nmr <- NanoMethResult(methy, sample_anno, exon_tibble)
plot_gene(nmr, "Peg3")
bsseq_dmr <- read.table(
    system.file(package = "NanoMethViz", "dmr_subset.tsv.gz"),
    sep = "\t",
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
plot_gene(nmr, "Peg3", anno_regions = bsseq_dmr)

workflows.name: modbam_direct_plotting
workflows.intent: Directly visualize methylation from modBAM files without converting to tabix format.
workflows.stages: 1. Define ModBamFiles with sample names and BAM paths ;; 2. Construct ModBamResult object ;; 3. Plot methylation patterns using plot_gene()
workflows.code:
mbr <- ModBamResult(
    methy = ModBamFiles(
        samples = "sample1",
        system.file(package = "NanoMethViz", "peg3.bam")
    ),
    samples = data.frame(
        sample = "sample1",
        group = 1
    ),
    exons = exon_tibble
)
plot_gene(mbr, "Peg3", heatmap = TRUE)

workflows.name: downstream_export_and_dim_reduction
workflows.intent: Export methylation data to BSseq and edgeR formats, and perform dimensionality reduction (MDS/PCA).
workflows.stages: 1. Convert NanoMethResult to BSseq using methy_to_bsseq() ;; 2. Convert BSseq to edgeR format using bsseq_to_edger() ;; 3. Convert BSseq to log-methylation-ratio matrix using bsseq_to_log_methy_ratio() ;; 4. Plot MDS using plot_mds() or PCA using plot_pca()
workflows.code:
nmr <- load_example_nanomethresult()
bss <- methy_to_bsseq(nmr)
gene_regions <- exons_to_genes(NanoMethViz::exons(nmr))
edger_mat <- bsseq_to_edger(bss, gene_regions)
gene_anno <- exons_to_genes(NanoMethViz::exons(nmr))
lmr <- bsseq_to_log_methy_ratio(bss, regions = gene_anno)
plot_mds(lmr) +
    ggtitle("MDS Plot")
plot_pca(lmr) +
    ggtitle("PCA Plot")
new_labels <- gsub("B6Cast_Prom_", "", colnames(lmr))
new_labels <- gsub("(\\d)_(.*)", "\\2 \\1", new_labels)
groups <- gsub(" \\d", "", new_labels)
plot_mds(lmr, labels = new_labels, groups = groups) +
    ggtitle("MDS Plot") +
    scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1")
plot_mds(lmr, labels = NULL, groups = groups) +
    ggtitle("MDS Plot") +
    scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1")
